|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Fallen Order]] (version 2 of 3). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Fallen Order]]): PC card image of 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-fa-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d7881b2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/fallenorder.gif fallenorder.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d7881b2 d7881b2] (2 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “If The Hidden Path on table, deploy on table. When deployed, stack three Jedi survivors from Reserve Deck here. During your deploy phase, Jedi survivors here may deploy as if from hand. The Light Will Fade: While The Hidden Path on table, Jedi survivors are deploy = 2, power = 3, forfeit = 3, deploy only to Safehouse, move using landspeed for free, and their game text is canceled. But It Is Never Forgotten: If your Jedi survivor was just lost, may stack it here. (Immune to Cold Feet.)”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 26 December 2025: “If The Hidden Path on table, deploy on table. When deployed, stack three Jedi survivors from Reserve Deck here. During your deploy phase, Jedi survivors here may deploy as if from hand. The Light Will Fade: While The Hidden Path on table, Jedi survivors are deploy = 3, power = 3, forfeit = 3, deploy only to Safehouse, move using landspeed for free, and their game text is canceled. But It Is Never Forgotten: If your Jedi survivor was just lost, may lose 1 Force to stack it here. (Immune to Cold Feet.)” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[Fallen Order (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. Game text: “2,” became “3,”; “lose 1 Force to” was added. The sheet PDF was created at 07:04 UTC on 26 December 2025, before the card image [[Fallen Order (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (01:21 UTC, 27 December 2025). Under the label “•Fallen Order” the sheet prints, pixel for pixel, the card image that the PC uploaded shortly afterwards as [[Fallen Order (Errata 2)]] (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Fallen Order (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 27 December 2025<ref name="ht-fa-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/21bad40/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/fallenorder.gif fallenorder.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/21bad40 21bad40] (27 December 2025).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC errata of 26 December 2025 (also on the re-issued [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet] and the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Set 26 Errata Combined PDF]): Jedi survivors are “deploy = 3” (was “deploy = 2”), and stacking a just-lost Jedi survivor now costs “lose 1 Force”. Text: “If The Hidden Path on table, deploy on table. When deployed, stack three Jedi survivors from Reserve Deck here. During your deploy phase, Jedi survivors here may deploy as if from hand. The Light Will Fade: While The Hidden Path on table, Jedi survivors are deploy = 3, power = 3, forfeit = 3, deploy only to Safehouse, move using landspeed for free, and their game text is canceled. But It Is Never Forgotten: If your Jedi survivor was just lost, may lose 1 Force to stack it here. (Immune to Cold Feet.)”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
